option_map_randomization.base_order: ascending SHA256(canonical JSON {salt, choice}) over the 43 canonical skill names plus JSON null

shallow_lexical_diagnostic.cross_validation: five-fold group holdout by registered skill or unsupported domain

label_audit_protocol.sampling_parameters: model-default; Codex CLI exposes no temperature, top_p, or seed controls
label_audit_protocol.exact_command_shape: codex exec --ephemeral --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --skip-git-repo-check --sandbox read-only; disable shell_tool, apps, browser_use, browser_use_external, computer_use, image_generation, in_app_browser, standalone_web_search, and multi_agent; exact slot model; model_reasoning_effort=high; bound output schema, JSON event stream, bound last-message capture, color never, unique empty isolated working directory, stdin '-'
label_audit_protocol.acceptance: for every one of 1032 rows the frozen answer receives at least 3 of 4 votes, including at least one Sol and at least one Terra vote

message_templates.open_system: You select coding-agent skills from a registry. Follow the requested output format and never fabricate registry evidence.
message_templates.structured_system: You are a closed-set skill selector. Respond only with one exact JSON object of the form {"choice":"Snnn"}, using one local option ID shown by the user. Do not add prose, Markdown, or extra keys.
message_templates.decontextualized_task_placeholder: The original task is deliberately withheld for this context-ablation arm.

multiplicity.family: Secondary D versus E one-sided exact McNemar tests across the two frozen models on A-invalid registered-skill targets
determination_precedence: any adequately powered model misses gain or adjusted-p gate => CONTEXT_MECHANISM_NOT_SUPPORTED

decision_rule: BOUNDED_EFFICACY_PASS requires every C direct-selector gate, absolute D registered-target recovery gate, D expected-NONE harm gate, and integrity gate to pass independently for both frozen models. Repair efficacy is evaluated only on A-invalid registered-skill targets; each model requires at least 200 such events. If either model has fewer than 200, repair efficacy is NOT_EVALUABLE and BOUNDED_SELECTOR_PASS may be reported only if every C gate and the D expected-NONE harm gate pass for both models and no adequately powered H2 absolute-recovery component fails. Any adequately powered primary semantic gate miss is a cross-model no-go. D-versus-E gain and Holm-adjusted McNemar evidence form a separate secondary CONTEXT_MECHANISM determination and do not erase an otherwise valid absolute efficacy result. Perfect constrained-output validity and easy NONE recovery cannot substitute for registered-skill recovery.
claim_boundary: This outcome-informed but newly preregistered extension tests closed-set selection and context-preserving repair against a clean frozen 43-name skill registry on fresh model-authored scenarios. It does not detect authentic malicious skills, load or execute skills, establish production prevalence, or demonstrate end-to-end agent safety. Gate 1 already showed that provenance alone admits authentic signed poisoned content; semantic poison screening and the originally reserved isolated-execution Gate 3 remain separate experiments.

retained_row_stochasticity.interpretation: The old all-1032 two-pass unanimity gate is sensitive to isolated fresh-run label noise on unchanged prompts.

label_audit_governance_rationale.tradeoff: The rule no longer claims four-way unanimity; it requires a stable, model-family-balanced supermajority and preserves every dissent.

retained_task_projection.reason: Label-independent option maps are assigned from corpus-wide sorted prompt rank; replacing nine prompts changes some retained ranks.
